Merged i8v3-coverage (47f3f27). ElevenLabs forced alignment WORKS (first end-to-end use in this repo; the key now has the forced_alignment scope, so docs/timestamp-pipeline.md's 'unverified' section is stale) and reaches every-line coverage on all three songs with no repair: mercury_records 62/62, fathers_prose_poem 67/67, wind_over_the_wheat_field 26/26, all PASS, all check-timestamps 0 errors. Two of my/the pilot's assumptions were wrong: (1) 'whole-second collisions are unfixable at @M:SS resolution' — no, they were a whisper-1 DP collapse, NOT a resolution limit (whisper put 4 lines on 29.98s with 0.00s spans and 3 more inside 60ms at 59.9s; ElevenLabs gives that verse a uniform 1.8-2.8s per line at confidence 1.00, and every min start gap across the three songs is 0.48-1.34s), so the standard's every-line rule needs no exception; (2) --repair is net-negative once every line is anchored — it may only move or drop, and it dropped a genuinely sung line on fathers_prose_poem (66/67) and the @4:05 hum line on wind (25/26). Accuracy vs the 8 hand-made condensed_blue_whale markers: ElevenLabs 5/8 within 1.5s, whisper 6/8 — both ~+1..2s late, so ElevenLabs buys coverage and stability, not better onsets. Spend for the whole experiment ~US/bin/bash.073 (ElevenLabs $0.22/audio-hour).
